Messages.Body:
Question

Can the playing of Taste of Vitae be timed so as to include blood lost from the
superior version of Drawing out the beast?

Thanks

JBW

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
nys...@cs.com (Nystulc) wrote:
> Can the playing of Taste of Vitae be timed so as to include
> blood lost from the superior version of Drawing out the beast?

No. DotB damage occurs at the end of the round, while Taste has to
be played after strike resolution (before the press stage).
